summary: Reads a 2-byte value from a caller-owned stream pointer and advances that pointer by 4 bytes. a1 points to a pointer slot; the slot value is incremented by 4 and the 16-bit value at its previous position is returned as a signed int. On-frame-path stream read helper.

operations.description: Advance the caller-owned stream pointer by 4 bytes: *a1 += 4.
Read the 2-byte value at the pointer's previous position (*(_WORD *)(*a1 - 4)) and return it as a signed 16-bit value.
Called by sub_58D04D (0x0058D04D) to consume 2-byte stream values from a shared stream pointer.

unresolved: 4-byte pointer advance paired with a 2-byte read: the read stride (2) differs from the pointer step (4), likely padding/alignment in the stream format.
Owning stream class and the meaning of the 4-byte step are unknown; a1 points to a pointer slot owned by the caller.
